name: Crow’s Toll
history: Before the establishment of the marquisate, merchants maintained a modest fortified waystation overlooking a difficult mountain crossing. The station collected contributions for road maintenance and provided shelter during storms. A newer route diverted much of the traffic, and the old station fell into disrepair.
current_state: A small Ash-Tusk raiding party has occupied the surviving enclosure and begun demanding payment from wagons still using the pass. The occupiers have repaired parts of the outer wall but lack the provisions to maintain a permanent garrison.
inhabitants: Ash-Tusk warriors and their camp attendants; occasional passing teamsters; pack animals. The raiding party’s leader and exact strength are undetermined.
danger_level: Moderate; potentially high if a larger Ash-Tusk warband is present.
discovery: A narrow mountain pass on an older ore-wagon route. Teamsters at the Overland Yard can identify the old route. The Iron Spurs have received reports of the unauthorized toll.
site_type: fort | Abandoned infrastructure; Faction strongholds | Disused fortified toll station; temporary raider camp
points_of_interest:
Ruined tollhouse; low stone enclosure; sheltered wagon yard; lookout platform; old road-maintenance ledger; partially collapsed footpath bypassing the crossing.

Unresolved elements: Whether the raiders act on orders or independently; what became of the station’s former keepers; whether the old bypass can be restored for wagon traffic.
